metadata.subtitle: Professor Bear's notes on Yuqing's design-track sponsorship triage
metadata.audience: Computational Skepticism students (INFO 7375) and anyone reweighting a model for a new sub-population
metadata.derived_from: Yuqing's UX/Product Designer Sponsorship Triage proposal + Computational-Skepticism feedback prompt
metadata.framing: Liam asks Claude what feedback Professor Bear would give the student. FIRST NAME ONLY — 'Yuqing', 'Professor Bear' / 'Bear'. Never the student's surname.
metadata.one_idea: A weights-profile is the right tool only if the old signals stay valid proxies for the new sub-population; for design roles they don't — the real risk (does the role even qualify as a specialty occupation?) is a MISSING signal, not a coefficient. New signal, not new weights.
